authority: Exact 42-image retail identity set. Asset closure is exact image name -> retail T6 filename hash paired with exact streamed dataHash, unique across supplied repositories, followed by reconstructed payload CRC29, IWI27, dimension, and PNG-semantic validation. Whole-IPAK SHA-256 identifies a source container instance and is provenance, not image identity.
sourceIdentityManifestPolicy: Historical repository/nameHash labels in v4 are non-authoritative. tools/t6_ipak_iwi_materialize_v3.py derives the retail IPAK filename hash from the exact image name and searches the exact (filenameHash,dataHash) pair across every supplied repository.

materializer.identityRule: exact image name -> retail T6 filename hash; pair with exact streamed dataHash; require exactly one match across base.ipak + mp.ipak
materializer.containerRule: Always record actual source IPAK size/SHA-256. Container SHA may optionally be pinned by a caller, but successful image promotion never follows from container identity alone.
payloadValidation: known retail IPAK command reconstruction including 0xCF padding

passCondition: A freshly generated t6-ipak-iwi-materialization-v3 manifest reports requested=42, materialized=42, unresolved=0, repositories.base.ipak=40, repositories.mp.ipak=2, all 42 rows exactKeyValidated=true and crc29Validated=true, and records the actual source container hashes used for that run.
proofBoundary: This contract defines the exact content-level gate and records currently known source-container instances. It does not claim payload closure merely because this file exists. Only a generated materialization manifest that satisfies passCondition closes the texture execution step; no filename similarity, dataHash-only fallback, cross-repository substitution, or unsupported decoder fallback is accepted.
